featured_reviews.name: John Elisa Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice Shop. Genuine products.  Staff is very helpful. Ambiance is good. Just bought a laptop and a phone.

featured_reviews.name: Aarti Javeri
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently made a purchase from Croma, and the experience was truly exceptional—far exceeding my expectations. We were exploring options about which laptop to buy (Mac vs Windows) and the sales personnel there (Sam) was extremely helpful. Instead of just mentioning the specs, he actually took the time to understand my needs. He showed us several options and allowed me to take time to assess multiple devices on display. The sales team was very transparent with regards to all the discounts available as well. We decided on a laptop which wasn’t available in store and it was arranged for me within 2 days! I was very pleased with the service . Not just that, upon receiving the laptop I wanted to just make sure the basic functions were okay and I spend almost 45 mins verifying them, during the process I was not only offered a chair , but even water and the sales personnel (Sam) made sure I was satisfied with my purchase within the store itself. Very highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: K Shashidhar
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the worst after sale service. I purchased fridge, TV, Washing machine and Hob, with a cost of Rs.86000/-. Once sold no installation support. Nice gesture till sale and thereafter no staff members of the showroom even respond properly. Worst experience. Buyers should be extra careful, whatever service required, it should be availed upfront before making full payment, otherwise it will be nightmare even for installation.

featured_reviews.name: Andrew
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely rude and unprofessional staff including managers. Went to buy an AC for my business the managers straight up said no to honour the deals that were going on which was an TV on purchase of AC.

Worst croma ever, ended up buying stuff from Vijay Sales who offered better service and professional staff.

featured_reviews.name: DrSantosh P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hidden Charges and Misleading Information – Pathetic Post-Purchase Service!
​Highly disappointed with Croma Sion. Before buying, you are told one thing, and post-purchase, the story completely changes.
​I recently purchased an AC from this store. While the company/brand clearly states that there are no installation charges, the store management and delivery team are now demanding extra "Handling Charges" and "Installation Charges."
​Taking full payment first and then surprising customers with hidden, unauthorized fees is a terrible business practice. This completely ruins the trust we place in a Tata enterprise. Total lack of transparency and pathetic customer care. Be very careful before billing anything here!

featured_reviews.name: Ayush Kuware
featured_reviews.review_text:
One thing which is very impressive
Is the sales man they have
We went to buy something else and bought the phone suggested by him
Trust me thats not a problem but a solution
Also they provide fast service
So you will save your time

featured_reviews.name: Parasnath Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have Visited croma Sion on 1st May, met 2 dynamic executive Danis Khan and Faizan Khan.

They gave me best deal for the day on Voltas AC.

Danish has good product knowledge and Faizan gave end to end product specification and offers related information.

But the most important thing is after sales service which I experienced from Faizan Khan was fabulous.

There was some error related to some information feeding in system and which was noticed by Faizan and closed by him by end to end follow up.

These both guys are very good at their individual capacity and these should should be motivated further.

Thank you Croma Sion, Thank you , Faizan and Danish for the services provided.

Last experience, 2 years back when I purchased  same voltas ac from croma and pathetic.

Hope in future we will experience same experience as we got on 1st May in coming future.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Chakote
featured_reviews.review_text: Very disappointed with the service from Chroma. We ordered an AC and after several days of delay, we were informed that the product was not even available. Now that the AC is finally available, the installation is again getting delayed without any proper communication or support. Such poor coordination and customer service, especially during summer, is unacceptable. Customers expect timely delivery and installation after making full payment. Highly dissatisfied with the overall experience.
